databases.title: Thermodynamic re-assessment of the Al-Co-W system
databases.assessment_scope: Critically reviewed Al-Co-W and binary-subsystem thermodynamics described in the cited publication.
databases.embedded_role: open assessed reference and release-qualification database
caveats: The cited assessment, not Ultra or pycalphad, defines the scientific validity domain.
A successful numerical solve does not validate extrapolation outside the assessed systems and conditions.
The publication reports ordered gamma-prime (L12_FCC) as metastable in the assessed ternary description; callers must not reinterpret a metastable calculation as equilibrium evidence.
Commercial or user-supplied databases require their own source, license, citation, hash, and validity metadata.
